incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging leo (oncall): p99 latency breach detected on shared-gpu-pool-2 for generation requests. alert_id=inc-2025-04-03-01 severity=high
leo (oncall): on it. grabbing dashboards now. which models/routes?
incident-bot: routes affected: /v1/generate (model: open-ada-ggml-1), streaming stalls observed, spike at 01:02 UTC. p95 -> 4200ms (baseline 220ms), p99 -> 18s (baseline 450ms). error rate up ~2% (stream disconnects).
leo (oncall): thanks. @mira can you join? likely noisy neighbor on shared-gpu-pool. I'm looking at per-node metrics.
mira (eng-sre): joining. pulling node-level metrics. initial look: node gpu0 on host i-gnr-034 shows GPU utilization steady ~95% but long gpu_queue_time spikes and blkio throttle events. running iostat and cgroup stats now.
sam (infra): thx. can you paste the iostat/cgroup snippet? suspect host disk IO is saturated by some tenant's checkpoint/restore.
mira (eng-sre): paste: ```iostat -dx 1 3
Device tps   kB_read/s kB_wrtn/s  rkB/s wkB/s rrqm/s wrqm/s 
sda   312  15000     8200      14800  200  0 0
...
``` also seeing cgroup blkio throttling counters incrementing: `/sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/tenant-42/blkio.throttle.io_service_bytes`: read spikes to 2.1GB/s.
leo (oncall): that matches streaming stalls — KV cache misses plus blocking IO. tenant-42 on same node?
mira (eng-sre): yes, tenant-42 has two long-running batch jobs (large dataset writes) on host i-gnr-034 and i-gnr-035. they have elevated blkio weight=100. other tenants default 500. looks like weight config was changed during a deploy yesterday.
sam (infra): who owns tenant-42?
anna (customer-success): tenant-42 is an internal POC customer flagged as high-throughput. CS flagged heavy usage last week. I'll message them for heads-up.
leo (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) throttle tenant-42 IO at cgroup level to protect inference paths 2) migrate latency-sensitive containers off affected nodes to dedicated-pool-dyn 3) enable fallback to quantized model variant for streaming while we stabilize 4) notify customers and mark incident. Assign actions: @mira take cgroup throttle and migrate, @sam help with migration scripts, @anna handle customer comms.
mira (eng-sre): running commands now: `echo "8:0 104857600" > /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/tenant-42/blkio.throttle.read_bps_device` (example). also setting blkio.weight for tenant-42 to 10.
leo (oncall): careful — lowering weight could impact their throughput. but necessary. record the commands you run.
mira (eng-sre): done on i-gnr-034 and i-gnr-035. applied per-node throttle and set weight to 50 (compromise). monitoring.
devops-bot: deploybot: migration job started: migrate-containers --from i-gnr-034 --to dedicated-pool-dyn --filter "route:generate" --parallel=4. job_id=mig-2025507890-1
sam (infra): started live container migration. using graceful draining: `CTRL-C` to stop new acceptance, then rsync state. latency-sensitive containers moved first.
leo (oncall): enabling model-fallback policy for /v1/generate to use open-ada-ggml-q8 variant on shared-pool as a temporary measure. config: `rollout: { route: "/v1/generate", fallback_model: "open-ada-ggml-q8", duration: 30m }`
mira (eng-sre): after throttle and migration start, cpu/gpu queue latencies dropping. p95 now ~480ms, p99 ~1.8s (still high but much better). streaming disconnects down to 0.2%.
anna (customer-success): message drafted for affected customers: "We're investigating increased latency on generation endpoints in shared GPU pool. We're mitigating by migrating impacted workloads and throttling noisy jobs. We'll update within 30 minutes." happy to send.
leo (oncall): please send to the 7 customers flagged as high-usage. mark CS ticket link in incident.
anna (customer-success): sent. responses: 2 customers asked for ETA on mitigation; I replied ~30-45m.
mira (eng-sre): migration job mig-2025507890-1 completed. one container failed to migrate (OOM while checkpointing) — restarted on dedicated-pool-dyn manually.
sam (infra): double-checked disk i/o: now read/write normalized, blkio throttle counters steady. GPU queue time reduced to baseline for moved hosts.
leo (oncall): good. can we roll back weight change on tenant-42 once their batch jobs finish? also create follow-up action to prevent unsafe weight changes during deploys.
mira (eng-sre): scheduled: create guardrail in infra-config to prevent weight < 100 for noisy-tenant label unless explicit ops approval. filing infra ticket INF-2025-342.
devops-bot: incident-log: created incident inc-2025-04-03-01, severity=high, status=mitigated, owner=leo. runbook steps recorded.
leo (oncall): current status summary for timeline: detection 01:02 UTC via p99 alert; investigation 01:04 (blkio throttle discovered); mitigation 01:10 (cgroup throttle + migration); improvement by 01:18; migration completed 01:22.
anna (customer-success): updating customer notes: customers with SLA alarms: 3 had degraded SLOs, none breached contractual credit threshold after mitigation.
mira (eng-sre): quick root-cause note: operator change in deploy pipeline accidentally applied reduced blkio.weight to tenant-42 group, combined with large dataset checkpoint IO, caused disk saturation leading to GPU queueing and streaming stalls.
leo (oncall): handing off to @mira for overnight monitoring and postmortem. I'm paged off at 02:00 UTC. mira, please include: metric snapshots, cgroup diff, migration logs, customer impact summary, actions taken, and remediation plan.
mira (eng-sre): ack. I'll keep alerting window open for 3h and create a detailed postmortem draft.
leo (oncall): thanks team. closing active mitigation channel now. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: note: next oncall (mira) acknowledged handoff at 01:40 UTC.
